title: Recover dropped Unity Catalog volumes with UNDROP VOLUME
body: You can now recover a dropped Unity Catalog volume within 7 days. Find its ID with `SHOW VOLUMES DROPPED`, then run `UNDROP VOLUME WITH ID` to restore it with its privileges and tags. Requires Databricks Runtime 19 and above. See [UNDROP VOLUME](/aws/en/sql/language-manual/sql-ref-syntax-ddl-undrop-volume).
